pairs.subject: fleet-orchestration
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/interview-sim/runner.ts:229 Contrary to the stale not-applicable verdict, the simulator is a fleet of model-driven sessions: a capped worker pool fans situations out, each writes its own dump file, and the run index accounts for ran/skipped/errored, so most of the subject's techniques are realized here.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/interview-sim/runner.ts:229 Concurrency is capped at opts.workers over one shared queue. Each conversation writes only its own `${s.id}.json`, so write sets are disjoint by construction.
app/_lib/interview-sim/runner.ts:232 The run record counts ran, errored and skipped. runConversation never throws, so every roster member lands with an endedBy.
app/_lib/interview-sim/runner.ts:190 A prior dump is reused only when the instrument and situation identity match. Stale or errored dumps are re-run fresh, never handed to the new attempt.
app/_lib/interview-sim/runner.ts:221 Each result is persisted atomically the moment it finishes, and the index is rebuilt from disk, so an interrupted run resumes.
app/_lib/interview-sim/types.ts:66 One closed end-state vocabulary. It keeps cap-fired (max_turns) and provider failure (error) apart from protocol ends.
app/_lib/interview-sim/detectors.ts:319 Parent-side deterministic detectors read the record, not the interviewer's own claim. An undecidable record is not_evaluable, never a pass.

app/_lib/interview-sim/detectors.ts:323 There are two limits: the clock and agenda in the brief, and the harness maxCalls cap. A cap-fired run is treated as truncated and fails 'completed'. Caveat: the cap is sized from the clock budget rather than the reverse, and no aggregate cap-fired fraction is printed.

app/_lib/interview-sim/engine.ts:255 The recovery budget is set at dispatch, in model calls, and it kills the run (ends max_turns). The judge deliberately does not get the private brief (judge.ts:7), which is in tension with 'give the watcher the spec'.
app/_lib/interview-sim/runner.ts:219 Each session is an awaited in-process promise that always resolves with an endedBy. Nothing can go silent, so there is nothing for a sweeper to find.
app/_lib/interview-sim/engine.ts:481 The two models play different roles (interviewer and candidate). They do not answer one question as a panel.

pairs.registryProposal: worker-trajectory-anatomy says to give the supervisor the worker's brief. An evaluation harness here deliberately keeps the private brief from its judge, so a judge built from the brief cannot grade the brief's own wording (judge.ts:7). The technique could name instrument-contamination as the case where the watcher gets the requirements but not the brief text.

pairs.subject: fleet-orchestration
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/devcase-orchestrator.ts:27 Fleet orchestration does not apply here. The devcase module drives one case through a stage machine inside a single background task, calling one LLM or Python step at a time, and its 'sessions' are human candidate attempts gated by session keys rather than a fleet of autonomous agent sessions. A search of app/_lib found no hibernation, session-registry, spawn-many or agent-session constructs.

pairs.subject: fleet-orchestration
pairs.evidence: app/api/agents/dispatch/spec-bounds.ts:26 The dispatch door sends the executor a hard maxTurns ceiling, and nothing in it derives a smaller budget for the agent's mission or system prompt. Execution reports only carry success or failure, so the fraction of runs where the cap fired cannot be measured and a cap-truncated run counts as a normal one.

techniques.evidence: app/api/agents/dispatch/spec-bounds.ts:26 Only one limit (the enforced cap). There is no derived budget in the brief and no cap-fired instrument. Mitigation: Personas authors the final agent brief.
app/api/agents/[id]/refresh/route.ts:104 Push and pull both go through the one transitionHiredAgent door, which compare-and-swaps on the status the decision was computed from and writes a ledger row.

app/api/agents/report/[token]/route.ts:134 Push reports are the primary signal, with poll refresh as the fallback. A liveness receipt is stamped before parsing, and silence is derived at read time as check_reporter (agentsWorkforceLogic.ts, outside this context), not written as a death.
app/api/agents/[id]/refresh/route.ts:93 A poll word with no mapping leaves the row unchanged. Nothing invents a status.
app/api/agents/dispatch/mint.ts:91 The durable row is minted before the outbound call. A bridge failure moves it to failed through the door (mint.ts:120), so no dispatch is lost from the roster.
